label.description: Visible label; names the thumbs unless thumbLabels is set.

value.description: Controlled value. A pair renders a range with two thumbs.

onValueChange.description: Called on every step while dragging or pressing keys.

onValueCommit.description: Called once when a drag is released or a key changes the value.

largeStep.description: Distance for PageUp, PageDown, and Shift with an arrow.

marks.description: Ticks on the track; labelled marks print under it and are clickable.

minStepsBetweenThumbs.description: Closest two range thumbs may sit, in steps.

format.description: Formats the readout, bubble, and spoken value.

showValue.description: Show the readout beside the label.

thumbLabels.description: Accessible names for the two range thumbs.

start.description: Content before the track, such as an icon.

name.description: Submits the value with a form, one hidden input per thumb.
